summary: Patient did not receive a reminder and forgot the appointment, requesting to reschedule for next week.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment for next week and verify contact details for reminders.

summary: Patient missed the appointment because they live far away and could not find transportation.
recommended_action: Reschedule and discuss telehealth options or transportation assistance.

summary: Patient missed the appointment because the consultation fee was too high and asked about discounts.
recommended_action: Provide information regarding any available discounts, financial assistance, or sliding-scale fees for follow-ups.

summary: Patient missed the clinic appointment due to high fever and body aches, and will reschedule after recovery.
recommended_action: Contact the patient to reschedule the appointment once they have recovered.

summary: Patient missed the clinic appointment due to an urgent work meeting.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment for an evening slot.

summary: Patient forgot the appointment because they did not receive an SMS reminder and wants to rebook.
recommended_action: Help the patient reschedule the appointment.

summary: Patient missed the clinic appointment due to a city bus strike and lack of available transport.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment and provide transport assistance options if available.

summary: Patient unreachable by phone after three attempts with phone switched off.
recommended_action: Retry contact at a later time or send a written notification.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a factory shift change and inability to take leave.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment for a Saturday as requested.
